items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: After you played that summer with Jimmy Jackson

ctx.x: 1922 - yes - he had a--- his father was very rich and he bought a place that looked like an old riverboat - up in Hillsdale, Michigan on a lake - yeah - and his--- the name of his band was "Jimmy Jackson's Royal K Jacksonian Society Syncopators ". Now, there's a name for you.
